evidence_classes.literature-anchored: an effect range reported in the cited work; a prior for this estate, not a measurement
evidence_classes.practice-anchored: an effect range from field practice without a single citable study; weaker prior
evidence_classes.house-observed: measured on this estate; receipt is a run record; supersedes the other two for this estate

note: Expected effects are priors with a class. Every commission's postmortem confirms or corrects them for this estate. Numbers here are the author's reading of the field as of mid-2026 and must be verified before external citation.

aug.audio.speed_perturb.name: Speed perturbation (0.9/1.0/1.1)
preconditions: admitted examples only; inherits source lawful basis
aug.audio.speed_perturb.failure_signature: regression on large strata beyond ceiling: rate distribution mismatch with production

aug.audio.specaugment.name: SpecAugment (time/frequency masking)
aug.audio.specaugment.when: held-out gap large or stratum < 5k examples
aug.audio.specaugment.failure_signature: no gain and slower convergence: base already regularised; reduce mask sizes

aug.audio.noise_rir.name: Noise and room-impulse augmentation
aug.audio.noise_rir.when: production capture noisier than calibration material (hall, phone line)

expected_effect.source: field practice; Ko et al. 2017 for RIR

preconditions: noise corpus with its own lawful basis

model.audio.lm_bias.name: Decoder language-model bias / lexicon boost for the register
model.audio.lm_bias.when: errors are lexical (Sheng vocabulary, named entities), not acoustic
model.audio.lm_bias.failure_signature: insertion errors rise: bias too strong

model.lora.rank.name: LoRA rank and target modules
model.lora.rank.when: curve flat with small gap (raise rank / add modules) or gap large (lower rank)

expected_effect.source: Hu et al. 2021 and rank ablations

model.lora.rank.failure_signature: no change across ranks: capacity is not the limit

model.schedule.name: Learning-rate schedule and warmup
model.schedule.when: unstable or plateaued curves at small volumes

model.optimizer.name: Optimizer comparison (AdamW vs Muon)
model.optimizer.when: only after rank and schedule are settled; the recipe seat's default comparison per A17.5

data.target_label.name: Targeted labelling of the hardest sub-stratum
data.target_label.when: error analysis shows a concentrated sub-stratum (a dialect, a form variant)
data.target_label.failure_signature: gain does not transfer to the stratum: sub-stratum was not the cause

data.clean.confident_learning.name: Confident-learning pass and re-annotation of flagged labels
data.clean.confident_learning.when: annotator agreement below policy floor or held-out plateaus below floor with a small gap
data.clean.confident_learning.failure_signature: flag rate > 20%: labelling protocol itself is broken; stop and fix the protocol

data.dedup_leakage.name: Deduplication and near-duplicate leakage check against the sealed set
data.dedup_leakage.when: always, before any lever; blocker if leakage found
data.dedup_leakage.failure_signature: held-out drops after dedup: the earlier number was inflated

data.restratify.name: Re-stratify on the hidden axis (capture condition, source)
data.restratify.when: per-source breakdown diverges from per-stratum; production condition differs

eval.enlarge_test.name: Enlarge the sealed test set for the stratum
eval.enlarge_test.when: gap to floor < MDE at current test_n
preconditions: items never seen by any training decision

aug.image.geometric_photometric.name: Geometric and photometric augmentation (rotation, skew, blur, exposure)
aug.image.geometric_photometric.when: photo captures vary; small form-type stratum
aug.image.geometric_photometric.failure_signature: scan-condition regression: augmentation range too wide

model.document.layout_vs_ocrfree.name: Layout-aware (OCR + layout) vs OCR-free encoder
model.document.layout_vs_ocrfree.when: form types differ by layout more than by text
model.document.layout_vs_ocrfree.failure_signature: OCR errors dominate: OCR-free wins on photos

data.text.instruction_quality.name: Instruction-data quality filtering over quantity
data.text.instruction_quality.when: LLM fine-tune with a large noisy instruction set

expected_effect.source: LIMA (Zhou et al. 2023) and data-quality follow-ups

preconditions: contamination check against the sealed set

model.text.contamination_check.name: Contamination check of training text against the sealed set

model.tabular.gbdt_first.name: Gradient-boosted trees before any neural model
model.tabular.gbdt_first.when: tabular with < 1M rows; the baseline to beat

expected_effect.metric: task metric vs neural at equal effort

data.tabular.leakage_time.name: Time-aware split and target-leakage audit
data.tabular.leakage_time.when: always for forecasting or any time-indexed table
data.tabular.leakage_time.failure_signature: metric collapses on a time split: earlier number was leaked

model.embed.hard_negatives.name: Hard-negative mining for retrieval fine-tuning
model.embed.hard_negatives.when: retrieval recall plateaus with random negatives

expected_effect.source: dense retrieval literature (e.g. Karpukhin et al. 2020 follow-ups)

model.embed.hard_negatives.failure_signature: false negatives poison training: mine with a cross-encoder filter

eval.embed.sealed_queries.name: Sealed query set per stratum with judged relevance
eval.embed.sealed_queries.when: always; retrieval evaluation without judged queries is not evaluation
